subtitle: Your installed APWorlds, and the community catalog to add more.
dropHint: Or drop an .apworld anywhere in the app.

noMatch.title: No world matches
noMatch.body: Try another search, or remove some filters.

ok.label: Ready
ok.help: Archipelago loads this world when it starts.

no-manifest.label: No manifest
no-manifest.help: It has no archipelago.json file: it works with Archipelago 0.6, but will not load with Archipelago 0.7.

incompatible.label: Incompatible
incompatible.help: It is not made for your Archipelago version, which will not load it.

corrupt.label: Corrupt
corrupt.help: The file cannot be read, and Archipelago refuses to start while it is there. Disable or remove it.

shadowed.label: Shadowed
shadowed.help: Another version of the same game comes first: Archipelago ignores this file.

core-loose.label: Built in
core-loose.help: Shipped with Archipelago as a folder: this world cannot be replaced.

disabled.label: Disabled
disabled.help: Set aside by ArchipelaGOAT: Archipelago does not load it. Enable it again whenever you like.

installed.restartHint: Restart the open Archipelago programs so that they notice.
installed.corruptBody_one: An unreadable file keeps Archipelago from starting. Disable or remove it.
installed.corruptBody_other: {{count}} unreadable files keep Archipelago from starting. Disable or remove them.
installed.emptyBody: Pick some from the community catalog, or drop an .apworld file anywhere in the app.

remove.title: Remove {{game}}?
remove.body: {{file}} goes to the ArchipelaGOAT backups: you can get it back by hand if you need it.

catalog.romHelp: Generating a game needs your own ROM of it. ArchipelaGOAT never provides one.
catalog.popTrackerHelp: A PopTracker pack exists to track your progress.
catalog.emptyBody: Nothing to show for now. Try again in a moment.
